correctness.rationale: The actual frozen RESULT.md defines unlabeled integer partitions and genuine Ferrers-cell transfers. Height strictly orders the two endpoints of every edge; all cliques have a unique top. For λ with t distinct-size blocks, the descending-neighbor graph is the line graph of a triangular bipartite graph with t(t−1)/2+Σ_j 1_{m_j≥2} edges and 2(t−1)+ρ_1+ρ_t active endpoint vertices. The exact clique-Euler cancellation χ(Cl(L(B)))=|V_+(B)|−|E(B)| yields local weight binom(t−2,2)+Σ_{2≤j≤t−1}1_{m_j≥2}, with the t=1 exception contributing exactly one. Summing proves χ=1+Σw. The published homotopy theorem (arxiv:2603.14370) supplies the independent all-n wedge shape. A monotone injection λ↦λ∪{1} and a strict witness (n−4,2,2) establish b_{n+1}≥b_n+1 for n≥7. Formal marked-part expansion gives the advertised generating identity. Fresh independent direct graph/clique/descending-link enumeration verified each n≤15, separate coefficients b25,b26,b30,b35, and coefficientwise Euler-product equality through n=42. These finite checks corroborate, but do not replace, the all-n proof; no further claim about higher homotopy or equivariant action is made.

value.rationale: The unknown sphere multiplicity is the natural exact invariant left implicit in the previously published partition-graph wedge theorem. The object and invariant are motivated independently of the computation, and this is not merely a single new finite table entry or routine rename of χ−1.
